test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Audacious
solution:
The correct answer is: **Brave**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Audacious **means showing a willingness to take bold risks or showing a lack of respect. (साहसिक जोखिम लेने की इच्छा दिखाना या सम्मान की कमी दिखाना)

 
 
• **For example- ***The audacious firefighter went into the burning building to save the trapped family.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Brave **means ready to face and endure danger or pain; showing courage. (खतरे या दर्द का सामना करने और सहने के लिए तैयार; साहस दिखा रहे हैं)
 
 
• **For example- ***They made a brave attempt to save the child.*
 
 
 
• According to the meaning, it is clear that 'Brave' is the most appropriate **synonym **for 'Audacious.'

Therefore, **option 1 **is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us look at the meaning of the other words.

 
 
• **Stifling**: Suffocating or oppressive. (दम घोंटने वाला या दमनकारी)
 
• **Lively**: Full of life and energy or active and outgoing. (जीवन और ऊर्जा से भरपूर या सक्रिय और मिलनसार)
 
• **Horrendous**: Extremely unpleasant, horrifying, or terrible. (अत्यंत अप्रिय, भयावह या भयावह)
